_readme: RECONSTRUCTED from HANDOVER.md because the original data/journey-matrix.json was not supplied. Replace with the original when available; keyword choices are directional, unvalidated (Brian Kim).

cells.pain_point: Thinks about heating only after the patio is built — or never
cells.opportunity: Plant heating in the first budget, alongside the pergola and lighting
cells.problem_to_solve: Outdoor space sits unused on cool evenings and shoulder seasons
cells.anchor_article: How to use your patio year-round: what actually works
cells.ai_prompt: How can I use my patio when it's cold?

cells.pain_point: Confused by electric vs gas vs 'infrared' and how many heaters a space needs
cells.opportunity: Become the sizing authority with a calculator that answers in a minute
cells.problem_to_solve: Fear of buying the wrong type or too few heaters
cells.anchor_article: Electric vs gas patio heaters: which suits your space
cells.ai_prompt: Are electric or gas patio heaters better?

cells.pain_point: No clear all-in cost: hardware, install, controls, running cost
cells.opportunity: Give a transparent cost model before a dealer conversation
cells.problem_to_solve: Sticker shock late in the project
cells.anchor_article: How much does it cost to run an outdoor heater?
secondary_keywords: electric patio heater cost per hour
cells.ai_prompt: How much does it cost to run a patio heater per hour?

cells.pain_point: Worried the heater will look wrong or sit in the wrong place
cells.opportunity: Offer a free layout from a specialist before purchase
cells.problem_to_solve: Placement, mounting height and spacing feel like guesswork
cells.anchor_article: Where to place patio heaters: height, spacing and clearance
secondary_keywords: how high to mount patio heater
cells.ai_prompt: How high should I mount an outdoor heater?

cells.pain_point: Unsure how to set up zones, schedules and the app after install
cells.opportunity: Make the first week effortless so the owner refers others
cells.problem_to_solve: Controls left unused; heat feels 'on or off' only
cells.anchor_article: Setting up Smart-Heat controls: zones, schedules and voice
cells.ai_prompt: Can I control my patio heater with Alexa?

cells.pain_point: Clients ask for outdoor rooms, but heating is left to the end
cells.opportunity: Position heating as part of the architectural brief
cells.problem_to_solve: Retrofit heaters clutter the soffit the architect designed
cells.anchor_article: Designing outdoor rooms for year-round use: what the 2026 data says
cells.ai_prompt: What are the outdoor living design trends for 2026?

cells.pain_point: Needs radiant theory, coverage and clearances quickly and exactly
cells.opportunity: Be the technical reference specifiers trust
cells.problem_to_solve: Mis-sized or mis-placed heat from generic assumptions
cells.anchor_article: Radiant heat outdoors: a specifier's guide to short, medium and long wave
cells.ai_prompt: What is the difference between short wave and long wave infrared heaters?

cells.pain_point: Needs spec language, details, BIM and coverage tables in the right format
cells.opportunity: Get Bromic written into the specification
cells.problem_to_solve: Substitution at bid because the spec was generic
cells.anchor_article: How to specify outdoor infrared heaters: a CSI-ready checklist
cells.ai_prompt: How do I write a specification for outdoor infrared heaters?

cells.pain_point: All-electric codes and gas restrictions make heating choices risky
cells.opportunity: Lead on electrification so electric is the default spec
cells.problem_to_solve: Gas specified, then blocked by code or the client's ESG goals
cells.anchor_article: All-electric outdoor heating: what electrification codes mean for patios
cells.ai_prompt: Are gas patio heaters allowed under all-electric building codes?

cells.pain_point: Coordination with electrician and integrator; submittals
cells.opportunity: Make Bromic the easiest product to get through construction
cells.problem_to_solve: RFIs and change orders around heater circuits and controls
cells.anchor_article: Outdoor heater submittals: a coordination checklist for architects
cells.ai_prompt: What should be in a submittal package for outdoor heaters?

cells.pain_point: Buyers want outdoor living; builders don't see heating as margin
cells.opportunity: Show heating as a high-value, low-effort upgrade
cells.problem_to_solve: Outdoor packages stop at the slab and the pergola
cells.anchor_article: Outdoor heating as a builder upgrade: what buyers will pay for
cells.ai_prompt: What outdoor upgrades add the most value to a new home?

cells.pain_point: No simple way to package heating across price points
cells.opportunity: Give a ready Good–Better–Best package
cells.problem_to_solve: Sales teams improvise options and leave money on the table
cells.anchor_article: Good, better, best: packaging outdoor heating for new homes
cells.ai_prompt: How should builders package outdoor heating options?

cells.pain_point: Heating decided after framing means retrofit wiring and callbacks
cells.opportunity: Lock in the pre-wire at rough-in
cells.problem_to_solve: Opening finished ceilings and walls to run circuits later
cells.anchor_article: Pre-wiring a patio for outdoor heaters: rough-in checklist for builders
cells.ai_prompt: What wiring should I rough in for patio heaters?

cells.pain_point: Unclear pricing tiers, margins and lead times
cells.opportunity: Make supply predictable and pricing simple
cells.problem_to_solve: Missed schedules and unprofitable upgrades
cells.anchor_article: Avoiding callbacks: five outdoor heater install mistakes
cells.ai_prompt: Why is my patio heater not warm enough?

cells.pain_point: Installer needs mounting, clearance and commissioning steps fast
cells.opportunity: Make every install right first time
cells.problem_to_solve: Callbacks for clearance, wiring or control pairing issues
cells.anchor_article: Installing electric patio heaters: mounting, clearance and commissioning
cells.ai_prompt: How do you install an electric patio heater?

cells.pain_point: Patio seats sit empty for months each year
cells.opportunity: Frame heating as revenue, not equipment
cells.problem_to_solve: Shoulder-season and evening covers lost
cells.anchor_article: How restaurants extend patio season with radiant heat
cells.ai_prompt: How can restaurants keep outdoor dining open in winter?

cells.pain_point: Propane is cheap to buy but costly to run and handle
cells.opportunity: Show the five-year total cost honestly
cells.problem_to_solve: Fuel choice made on purchase price alone
cells.anchor_article: Propane vs natural gas vs electric patio heaters: five-year cost for operators
cells.ai_prompt: Is propane or electric cheaper for restaurant patio heaters?

cells.pain_point: Needs a payback case the owner or landlord will sign
cells.opportunity: Turn the patio into a capex case with numbers
cells.problem_to_solve: No business case means no budget
cells.anchor_article: Patio heater ROI: how to calculate payback for a restaurant patio
cells.ai_prompt: How do I calculate ROI on restaurant patio heaters?

cells.pain_point: Permits, fire code and landlord approvals slow every site
cells.opportunity: Give a clear permit and code checklist with primary sources
cells.problem_to_solve: Projects stall at permitting
cells.anchor_article: Outdoor heater permits and fire code: a checklist for restaurants
cells.ai_prompt: Do I need a permit for restaurant patio heaters?

cells.pain_point: Running heaters well across sites: zones, schedules, maintenance
cells.opportunity: Make operations easy so the next site is Bromic
cells.problem_to_solve: Heaters left on, staff confusion, inconsistent guest comfort
cells.anchor_article: Running a heated patio: zones, schedules and maintenance for operators
cells.ai_prompt: How do I maintain commercial patio heaters?
